COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C482 No.1006 of 2024
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Maneesh Bisht, learned 
counsel for the applicants.
2. Mr. V.S. Pal, learned AGA, along 
with Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel 
for the respondent.
4. Today, both the parties are 
present in the Court. The complainant 
submits that a total expenditure of 
Rupees 4,00,000/- (Rupees Four Lacs 
Only) were incurred in engagement,
and, thereafter, an expenditure of 
Rs.9,00,000/- (Rupees Nine Lacs Only)
were also incurred for marriage. 
Hence, the complainant has suffered a 
loss of Rupees 15 lacs approximately.
5. Learned counsel for the 
applicants prays for and is granted one 
week’s time to file affidavit for clearing 
all the expenditure as incurred by the 
respondent-complainant at the time of
engagement and marriage of her 
daughter or to show cause.
6. Put up this matter on 
09.07.2024. On that day, both the 
parties shall remain present in the 
Court.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 27.06.2024
R.Bisht

Mr. Ravindra S. Rawat, Advocate holding brief of Mr. 
L.K. Tiwari, Advocate for the applicants, through video 
conferencing.
2. Mr. S.C. Dumka, A.G.A. with Ms. S.B. Dobhal, B.H. for 
the State.
3. Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate for respondent no.2.
4. Misc. Application (IA No.2 of 2025) is allowed. 
Rejoinder affidavit filed on behalf of the applicants is taken 
on record.
5. Learned proxy counsel for the applicants seeks 
adjournment on the ground that the arguing counsel is out 
of town in respect of some personal work. 
6. Learned counsel for respondent no.2 has serious 
objection to the adjournment sought by counsel for the 
applicants for the reason that they have got interim order in 
their favour and are just try trying to prolong the matter by 
seeking unnecessary adjournment.
7. On the submission of counsel for the parties, in the 
interest of justice, the matter is adjourned.
8. List this case on 25.08.2025.
9. In the meantime, State may also file counter affidavit.
10. Interim order dated 05.06.2024 is extended, till the 
next date of listing.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
